name: ml-classical-ml
description: Use when the user asks to train a gradient boosting model on tabular data, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, scikit-learn pipelines, random forest, SVM, clustering, PCA or cross-validation. Produces a leakage-safe sklearn pipeline, model choice and tuning starting points. Not for neural networks (use ml-deep-learning) or search frameworks (use ml-hyperparameter-tuning).
